text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf and I are training on<n>the track when
an unexpected visitor<n>appears.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I need to have a word with you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Brian? What brings you here?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The director barged her way into the<n>student council
office and started<n>ranting about some kind of
emergency.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It seemed like a pain, so I figured I'd<n>let you sort it
out.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I see. I had better take care of this<n>immediately.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer, but I need to speak<n>with Brian. I
shouldn't be long.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This matter has turned out to be far<n>more complex
than I anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Addressing it will require some<n>decisive moves on
the part of the<n>student council president—which is to
say, me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm afraid I need some time to bring it<n>to a proper
resolution.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Actually, it might take the rest of the<n>day to deal
with.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Although, if I were to prioritize only<n>the parts that
require my input, I could<n>be done in short order.
choice_data_list: Take the time to do it right.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You're correct, of course. Thank you<n>for
understanding.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I will spend the rest of the day giving<n>this matter my
full attention.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'll see you tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
True to her word, Symboli Rudolf<n>resolves Director
Akikawa's<n>emergency within the day.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Of course. I won't be long.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm back. Sorry to have kept you<n>waiting.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I told you I could do my part in short<n>order, didn't I?
Brian and the others<n>will start work on the rest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Not to worry. I will rejoin them once<n>we are finished
here.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now, where were we?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
True to her word, Symboli Rudolf<n>manages to
navigate her obligations<n>with the finesse I've come
to expect.
